defect_ledger.title: Price table feature availability checklist and badge alignment
defect_ledger.description: Validated price table feature checklist items availability states and featured badge positioning.

defect_ledger.title: Testimonial circular avatar containment and quote typography
defect_ledger.description: Validated testimonial widget with circular avatar shrink-0 protection and italic quote styling.

defect_ledger.title: Image box aspect ratio containment and share buttons platform resolution
defect_ledger.description: Validated image box aspect-video container styling and share buttons platform mapping.

defect_ledger.title: Social links repeater and RTL blockquote border alignment
defect_ledger.description: Validated social links interactive buttons and RTL-aligned blockquote border-s-4 styling.

defect_ledger.title: Interactive form container honeypot anti-spam and input widgets
defect_ledger.description: Validated form container with anti-spam honeypot input, form inputs, checkboxes, and radio options.

defect_ledger.title: Animation timing duration and delay unit resolution
defect_ledger.description: Validated entrance animation duration and delay seconds mapping and hover box shadow transitions.

defect_ledger.title: Scoped CSS {{WRAPPER}} selector resolution and isolation
defect_ledger.description: Implemented and verified resolveScopedCss ensuring custom CSS rules targeting {{WRAPPER}} are cleanly scoped to the element.

defect_ledger.title: Code highlight terminal header and strict LTR rendering encapsulation
defect_ledger.description: Validated code highlight widget LTR direction preservation and terminal title bar in RTL builder canvas.

defect_ledger.title: Nested containers and tabs preview state encapsulation
defect_ledger.description: Validated nested container tabs switching and accordion child element hierarchy without DOM leakage.

defect_ledger.title: Complex e-commerce landing suite layout and type alignment
defect_ledger.description: Validated product grid, mega menu and customer proof rating components with strict TypeScript flexbox layout alignment.

defect_ledger.title: Full landing page creation stress test and container grid layout validation
defect_ledger.description: Validated that multi-section landing pages with flex and grid containers render and update with zero hydration or layout errors.

defect_ledger.title: Wave 3 multi step form and loop grid responsive state synchronization
defect_ledger.description: Validated that multi step form navigation and loop grid dynamic cards render seamlessly across responsive viewports.

defect_ledger.title: Interactive Pro widgets flip box and call to action 3D rendering
defect_ledger.description: Validated that 3D flip card and call to action interactive widgets render smoothly without console or hydration errors.

defect_ledger.title: Elementor Wave 1 transform and mask state controls validation
defect_ledger.description: Validated that transform (rotate, scale, skew, flip) and mask controls cleanly update device styles without style bleed.

defect_ledger.title: Responsive value mobile-first resolution cascade validation
defect_ledger.description: Verified that resolveResponsiveValue preserves mobile-first inheritance for desktop and tablet without mutating AST elements.

defect_ledger.title: Save page template dialog integration and display conditions mapping
defect_ledger.description: Validated that page template saving correctly packages entire AST with theme builder template types and conditions.

defect_ledger.title: Global styles design token resets and primary token isolation
defect_ledger.description: Validated that resetting global styles restores clean site theme defaults without polluting page AST or leaking to admin UI.

defect_ledger.title: Typography font weight type safety in inspector styles normalization
defect_ledger.description: Standardized font weight string tokens to strict numeric string representation (700 for bold) avoiding type drift.

defect_ledger.title: Action buttons in layers-tree required hover to become visible
defect_ledger.description: Removed hover dependency for layer actions (hide, duplicate, delete), locking them to permanent opacity-100.

defect_ledger.title: Vertical scroll trap in InspectorPanel and flexbox chain missing min-h-0
defect_ledger.description: InspectorPanel left column flexbox chain lacked min-h-0 on parent containers. Added min-h-0 and pb-24 clearance ensuring all 3 tabs scroll completely.

defect_ledger.title: Horizontal clipping in Style tab controls and toolbar buttons overlap in 1280x720
defect_ledger.description: Added reset buttons for Padding and Margin in InspectorPanel Style tab, responsive labels and shrink-0 preventing button collisions in 1280x720 and 1440x900 viewports.

defect_ledger.title: Single icon widget rendered raw text or missing SVG in canvas and backend ast_compiler
defect_ledger.description: Created unified icon-registry.ts, updated canvas-element with data-widget-type and Lucide SVG, and upgraded backend AST compiler to output valid sanitization-compliant SVG vector paths.

defect_ledger.title: Canvas default content RTL guidance incorrectly pointed to left panel instead of right panel
defect_ledger.description: Corrected initial text guidance in RTL layout from پنل سمت چپ to پنل سمت راست matching BlocksPalette physical position.

defect_ledger.title: Sticky Header and Z-Index clearance during Landing Hero drag-drop
defect_ledger.description: Sticky container overlaps canvas toolbar when hero section height exceeds viewport. Fixed by dynamic clearance calculation in canvas-overlay-layer.

defect_ledger.title: Pricing Table Currency Unit localization and RTL column spacing in Landing section
defect_ledger.description: Price table currency text alignment flips on mobile viewport in canvas. Fixed by explicit dir=rtl, flex alignment, subtitle/period support and ast_compiler parity.

defect_ledger.title: Multi-Step Form progress indicator contrast in dark mode on canvas
defect_ledger.description: Step number badge lacks sufficient contrast against active step background. Fixed with high-contrast WCAG 4.5:1 classes and border ring.

defect_ledger.title: Call To Action button hover transition duration missing explicit unit mapping
defect_ledger.description: Hover state transitionDuration in device style requires standard seconds format. Fixed with unit mapping for seconds and milliseconds.

defect_ledger.title: Missing SSR HTML compilation for floating_bar widget
defect_ledger.description: floating_bar widget was missing from backend AST compiler leading to fallback unknown widget div in SSR. Fixed with full semantic HTML compilation.

defect_ledger.title: Backend 422 validation rejection for floating_bar type during autosave
defect_ledger.description: STANDARD_WIDGET_TYPES in validation engine lacked floating_bar causing 422 error on autosave. Fixed by adding floating_bar to allowed types.

defect_ledger.title: Floating bar mobile layout button wrap and phone text overlap
defect_ledger.description: In 375px mobile viewport, call button wrapped awkwardly over text. Fixed with flex-col sm:flex-row responsive layout.

defect_ledger.title: Duplicate price_table switch case in canvas-element shadowing updated features
defect_ledger.description: Earlier price_table case at line 1704 shadowed line 1939. Consolidated to full featured version.

defect_ledger.summary: String features in block registry caused blank feature lines in canvas due to missing text field normalization
Feature inputs were rendered with empty values in inspector when features array contained strings
ast_compiler threw AttributeError if features array contained strings instead of dicts
Badge prop was ignored unless is_featured was true, and was hardcoded to 'پیشنهاد ویژه'
button_text in block registry was not recognized by canvas-element expecting button_label
Duplicate dead code case price_table at line 1929 shadowing active case
Button click was unhandled, risking form submission or page jump in canvas preview
button_text fallback missing when button_label is omitted
Code snippet text-align was forced to right by Tailwind dir=rtl text-left rule, causing ugly right alignment
Hero slides widget was locked on slide 1 and navigation dots were non-interactive
ast_compiler only handled background_image for slides, ignoring bg_color CSS gradients
Early return in inspector for type container blocked specialized controls for nested_tabs and nested_accordion
Canvas lacked interactive tab navigation pills, stacking all tab containers vertically
ast_compiler did not recognize tab_titles and item_titles when compiling specialized containers

defect_ledger.title: Loop Grid and Loop Carousel widgets missing dedicated canvas render cases
defect_ledger.description: loop_grid and loop_carousel fell into product_grid or default fallback on canvas. Fixed with full product cards, responsive grid, and carousel arrows.

defect_ledger.title: Missing inspector controls for loop_grid and loop_carousel
defect_ledger.description: Inspector lacked controls for category filter, columns selector, show price, and show button for loop widgets. Implemented dedicated controls.

defect_ledger.title: Multi-Step Form hardcoded navigation buttons and missing backend .env jwt secret
defect_ledger.description: Canvas ignored prev_button_text and next_button_text configured in inspector, and backend returned 500/401 on autosave. Fixed props binding and synced .env.

defect_ledger.title: Multi-Step Form step indicator text wrapping awkwardly on mobile viewports
defect_ledger.description: Step indicator headers cramped on 375px mobile viewport. Added responsive flex-wrap and gap-2 spacing.

defect_ledger.summary: Inspector aside and subcontainers lacked min-h-0 and had lg:block overriding flex, freezing vertical scrolling
Radix portals had z-50 rendering underneath full-screen BuilderStudio (z-100), fixed by elevating to z-150
Multi-step form lacked step repeater addition/removal, indicators, and live canvas step navigation
Missing 'breadcrumbs' in backend STANDARD_WIDGET_TYPES causing 422 Unprocessable Content error during autosave and draft save
Breadcrumbs missing semantic microdata (Schema.org BreadcrumbList / ListItem) and ol/li markup in ast_compiler.py and canvas-element.tsx
Missing comprehensive test suite and block-registry coverage assertion for breadcrumbs, search_bar, and nav_menu in backend pytest and frontend vitest
Search Bar and Nav Menu widgets lacked explicit data-widget attributes in canvas-element, preventing reliable inspector auto-selection
Nav Menu widget lacked vertical vs horizontal layout orientation controls across Inspector, Canvas, and SSR AST compiler
Search Bar button lacked data-testid and fallback recognition for button_label property
Custom Attributes parsed only string format and failed dictionary objects; extra_attrs was missing on most widget root tags in SSR
Frontend Zod schema rejected dictionary format for customAttributes in PageAST
canvas-element printed raw string text instead of Lucide vector icon for icon widget and hardcoded Sparkles in icon_box
ast_compiler hardcoded star icon symbol in icon widget and checkmark in icon_list; fixed with centralized ICON_CHAR_MAP
ast_compiler used img tags for shape dividers which dropped custom fill color; replaced with inline SVG vectors maintaining full color parity
bleach Linker and html_sanitizer dropped svg and path tags, escaping them in SSR output
Duplicate partial Shape Divider control in Advanced tab removed; consolidated in Style tab with color picker
Inspector animation selector lacked test-id and Elementor keyframes bounce-in/rotate-in options
globals.css was missing @keyframes for builderBounceIn and builderRotateIn
